rejected.why: The query 'Did the Sierra Leone Civil War or the RUF conflict involve the Mende ethnic group?' targets a concrete factual/entity question and returned genuinely relevant documents; it is not a meta-evaluative question about the claim's truth or about summaries, so SP_06 does not apply.

This flags the same query already captured under the redundant-repetition point; the taxonomy explicitly excludes SP_06 for queries that repeat prior-hop facts, so it is not a separate meta-evaluative failure and is folded into the SP_05 point.
